description: Members of the Swiss Federal Parliament (National Council 200, Council of States 46) from the Parliamentary Services' open data web service ws.parlament.ch, refreshed daily: council, canton, party, parliamentary group and function, seat number, career in both chambers since joining, year and place of birth as published (never the full date), occupations with employer, mandates, committees and delegations with function, declared interests (Art. 11 Parliament Act: organisation, legal form, body, function, paid or unpaid), the official e-mail address and own website shown on the parlament.ch profile, and social media accounts the member links from their own website (only accounts whose handle carries the member's name). With name (or part of it) or id: matching members in full; with canton, council (NR or SR) or party (abbreviation) only: the matching list. Neutral facts only: no ratings.

lang.description: de, fr or it for committee and interest labels (default de)

name.description: name or part of it, optional

party.description: party abbreviation (e.g. SP, SVP, FDP-Liberale, M-E, GRÜNE, glp), optional

name: parliament_member
title: Federal Parliament members
